name: yuan
description: Yuan (源) v7.2 — Enforces WorkBuddy built-in AskUserQuestion popup selection, Matt Pocock's Grill-Me -> To-Spec -> To-Tickets -> Implement-Spec -> Differential-Review pipeline, 4-dimension cognitive mapping, 3-Gear adaptive dispatch, mandatory post-edit Spec-vs-Diff review, and 4-step Git patch/prod/squash discipline.

displayDescription.en: Grill-Me alignment, 4-dimension plain-language mapping, 3-gear adaptive dispatch and mandatory post-edit review: 1 lead plus 5 specialists covering architecture, simplicity gatekeeping, prior-art research, UI craft and TDD implementation.
displayDescription.zh: 强制内置弹窗选择(AskUserQuestion) → 拍板后强制落盘 Spec/Tickets 单一事实源 → 三档并发按规施工 → 改后对照 Spec 独立复审：天枢率五位专家全流程守护。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to build: {describe goal}. Pre-fetch local code and high-star GitHub prior art silently, then present a 4-dimension comparison and 1-3 gear choice for my sign-off before coding.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想做：{输入需求}。请先静默检索本地代码与高星开源方案，按四维对比与 1~3 档强度供我拍板后再写代码。

quickPrompts.en: I want to build: {describe goal}. Pre-fetch local code and high-star GitHub prior art silently, then present a 4-dimension comparison and 1-3 gear choice for my sign-off before coding.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想做：{输入需求}。请先静默检索本地代码与高星开源方案，按四维对比与 1~3 档强度供我拍板后再写代码。

quickPrompts.en: Diagnose and fix: {describe issue}. Silently trace the full call graph and root cause first, confirm the fix option with me, then implement, verify via subagent review, and archive a .patch.
quickPrompts.zh: 排查并修复：{输入问题}。先静默定位全调用链根因，找我拍板方案后修改，并强制调用子代理复审与归档 patch。

quickPrompts.en: Audit current changes (>80% confidence): dispatch Chengche and Qiaoduo to independently review git diff for missed callers, concurrency/resource leaks, and code elegance before squash/PR.
quickPrompts.zh: 独立审查当前改动：调用澄澈与巧夺按 >80% 置信度核查全调用链遗漏、并发安全爆炸半径与代码优雅度。
